title: fix(react,app-shell): label search hits from the fields the viewer may read (objectui#10500)
body:
Fixes #10500
Clause-②: no

No export, schema, declared key or accept set moves. `useRecordSearch` gains one optional member on its existing exported options interface, `fieldReadPolicy`, typed inline (no new named type). The gate itself, `readableRow`, is module-private: `packages/react/dist/hooks/useRecordSearch.d.ts` has 0 hits for it.

## What changed

A search hit is now labelled from the record as the viewer may read it. `useRecordSearch` takes an optional `fieldReadPolicy`, which is `usePermissions()` from `@object-ui/permissions`. Once that policy is loaded, the hook removes the fields it denies on the hit's object, keeping `id` and `_id`, before any `getDisplayName` resolver reads the row. That applies on both of the hook's data paths: `searchAll` hits that carry a record but no server title, and the per-object `find` fanout. It follows the objectui#10411 / objectui#10434 rule, `!perms.isLoaded || perms.checkField(object, field, 'read')`. A denied field reads exactly as an absent one, and `getRecordDisplayName` falls through to its next rung, the label a stripping backend (ObjectStack's `FieldMasker`) already yields. There is no placeholder mask.

The rule is spelled once, in the hook. The three surfaces only pass the policy (`const perms = usePermissions()` plus `fieldReadPolicy: perms`):

- `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/SearchResultsPage.tsx`
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/global-search-renderer.tsx`

**When the policy loads after the hits.** The policy's `isLoaded` primitive is a dependency of the search effect, so a search already on screen runs again when the policy loads, and hits labelled before that are relabelled from the gated row. The case this matters for is a deep link to the results page (`/apps/APP/search?q=...`), which searches 250ms after mount and can beat the permissions answer. Only the primitive is keyed. The policy object itself is read through a ref, as `getDisplayName` already is, so an inline policy object (a new object every render) never re-runs the search by identity (the objectui#10044 class, AGENTS.md Commandment 10).

`packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts` is untouched. `getRecordDisplayName` is consumed as it stands.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **Z2-1 (the four files, no permission read): holds.** The three callers pass `getDisplayName: getRecordDisplayName` to `useRecordSearch`, and none of the four files read `usePermissions` or `checkField` on base `f94cfa5ec`. **Reproduced on every surface** by running this PR's pins on base with no fix: 12 failed and 12 passed (24). Each surface had 4 red and 4 green. Every red was `Expected "Ada Lovelace"` / `Received "ada@example.com"`, over both data paths, for a denied `titleFormat: '{email}'` token and a denied `nameField: 'email'`. The controls were green.
- **Z2-2 (what objectui#10491 left, and which seam): nothing shared exists.** `withoutDeniedFields` in `packages/plugin-detail/src/withoutDeniedFields.ts` is not on that package's entry, and `RecordDetailView.tsx` holds a module-private copy. So I chose the hook option over the callers wrapping `getRecordDisplayName`, because it is the smaller correct change:
  1. The hook is the one seam all three surfaces share, and the gate runs before ANY resolver, including a caller-supplied one.
  2. A caller-side wrap cannot relabel hits made before the policy loaded. The hook reads resolvers through a ref and deliberately never re-runs on their identity (objectui#10044).
  3. A wrap would need a new app-shell module, outside the claim's file surface. This diff stays inside it.
  4. `@object-ui/react` has no `@object-ui/permissions` dependency, so the policy is typed structurally as `isLoaded` plus `checkField`, and no dependency was added.
- **Z2-3: holds.** `record-title.ts` is not in the diff.
- **Z2-4 (objectui#10501): the helper does not serve it.** `readableRow` is module-private to `useRecordSearch.ts`. `resolveLookupRecordName` in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` resolves an expanded record directly and never goes through `useRecordSearch`. See the Acceptance notes for the shared-export question.

## Pins

- `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.searchLabelFls-10500.test.tsx` (8 tests): the real `CommandPaletteProvider`, opened by `?palette=1`, and the real `PermissionProvider`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/SearchResultsPage.searchLabelFls-10500.test.tsx` (8 tests): the real hook under a deep-linked `?q=`, where the existing `SearchResultsPage.records.test.tsx` stubs the hook.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/global-search.searchLabelFls-10500.test.tsx` (8 tests): `GlobalSearchRenderer` under the real providers.

Each surface pin runs both data paths. For a denied `titleFormat` token or `nameField`, the label falls through to `name`, and the denied value appears nowhere in `document.body.innerHTML`: not as text, and in the palette not in the cmdk item's `data-value` either. There are two controls. A lit one: a policy denying `phone` prints the allowed `ada@example.com`. And no provider (`isLoaded` false) prints the served label.

- `packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useRecordSearch.fieldReadPolicy-10500.test.tsx` (10 tests), over both paths:
  - the resolver receives the gated row with `id` kept;
  - a denied token in `'{name} - {email}'` falls through to `Ada Lovelace`;
  - with every field denied, `id` included, the label is the `Record #K1` floor;
  - CONTROL: a policy that is not loaded hands the resolver the same object as served.

  Plus two run-decision pins. The shown hits are relabelled once the policy loads. An inline policy object that is new every render does not re-run the search.

## Reverse proofs

Each proof ran through `node ../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, inside a script with an EXIT/INT/TERM trap and absolute paths. Every anchor hit 1 and went to 0, and the on-disk marker count was 1 during the run. Every restore ended with the blob equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`, checked by the tool and again by the script. On resolution: the app-shell pins reach the mutated file through the vitest alias `'@object-ui/react'` to `./packages/react/src` in `vitest.config.mts`, so no `dist/` is involved.

- **A1, the gate removed** (`readableRow` returns the row as served). I predicted 19 red and 15 green before the run, and measured 19 red and 15 green at `f84e7434a`, then again at the final head `3b1103470`.
  - Red: all 12 surface denied cases (4 per surface), the 6 hook gate cases (3 per path) and the relabel pin.
  - Green: all 12 surface controls, both not-loaded hook controls and the inline-policy pin. No CONTROL went red.
  - Blobs: `ac0811aded09` to `b8be5fe36c3f` to `ac0811aded09` at `f84e7434a`, and `ea957cba6840` to `a04c0f3b529a` to `ea957cba6840` at `3b1103470`.
- **A2, the `policyLoaded` dependency removed:** 1 red and 33 green at `f84e7434a`. The red is exactly the relabel pin, as predicted.
- **A3, the `id` / `_id` exemption removed:** 2 red and 32 green at `f84e7434a`, where I predicted 1. I expected only the fanout `Record #K1` floor to go red, reasoning that the `searchAll` path's own `Record #` fallback would catch the other. It does not: `getRecordDisplayName` answers `Untitled` for an id-less row, which is not empty, so that fallback is never reached (`Received: "Untitled"`). The exemption carries weight on both paths.

## Verification (final head `3b1103470`)

- **Closure build:** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` ran 28/28, 2 of them cached. This includes `@object-ui/react`, and the rebuilt `.d.ts` carries `fieldReadPolicy`.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) both exit 0.
  - `--listFiles`: the react test program lists the hook pin, and the app-shell test program lists all 3 surface pins.
  - The app-shell compile passes an object literal carrying `fieldReadPolicy`, and the pre-change type would reject that key as an excess property, so the green is a read of the rebuilt `.d.ts`.
  - After the typing-only commit `3b1103470`, `react` was rebuilt and `useRecordSearch.d.ts` hashes identically (sha256 `781b9cdb`), so the app-shell result stands.
- **vitest from the repo root** (a union of 94 files, 1008 tests, all passed at `3b1103470`):
  - `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/`, `packages/react/src/hooks/` and `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/`;
  - every other suite naming `CommandPalette`, `SearchResultsPage`, `GlobalSearchRenderer` or `useRecordSearch`: `AppContent.systemHubRoutes`, `adr0054-ratchet`, `AppPreview`, `ActionPreview.locations`, `exclusion-reason-truthfulness`, `searchItemsAvailable-plural-9664`, `check-i18n-dead-keys`, `relationalMetaCopySet-6874` and `ObjectView.titleFieldConvergence`.
- **Against current `main`:** a scratch tree of `origin/main` `d22b37bd8`, which includes objectui#10555's `record-title.ts` change, with this branch's 9 files applied. The 4 pins plus `useRecordSearch.test.ts` gave 5 files and 57 tests passed. The scratch tree has been removed.
- **Gates at `3b1103470`, all exit 0:**
  - `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims` and `check-changeset-no-major`;
  - `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:unreferenced-sources` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`.
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`.** Reason: it needs every package's `dist/` on disk (86 imports "could not be judged", starting with app-shell's own unbuilt entry), and this diff touches no README.
- **eslint** `--no-inline-config` over the 8 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors. Every per-rule count against base is unchanged, and the new files have 0 messages.
- **Left to CI, not run locally:** the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the `pnpm test` shards, and Build and E2E.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/10500-search-labels-read-gate.md` declares a `patch` for `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Acceptance notes

These are out of scope. They were measured and not edited.

- **Server-computed text.** A `searchAll` hit's `title` and `snippet` are shown as the server sent them. The server that computes them is the one that judges them, and the renderer cannot tell which field a title or snippet came from. This is written into the option's JSDoc and the changeset.
- **`raw` stays the served row.** The option's JSDoc and `RecordSearchHit.raw` say so. None of the three surfaces reads `hit.raw`.
- **A policy whose content changes while `isLoaded` stays true** relabels on the next run, not at once. Only the primitive is keyed, which is what keeps an inline policy from re-running the search by identity.
- **The shared-export question** (the triage's "decide with objectui#10501"). The field-read rule is now spelled in the hook, in `withoutDeniedFields.ts` (plugin-detail), in `RecordDetailView.tsx` (app-shell), and in `LookupField.tsx`, `RecordPickerDialog.tsx` and `PeoplePicker.tsx` (fields).
  - This card did not need a shared export: `@object-ui/react` cannot reach `@object-ui/permissions` without a new dependency.
  - For objectui#10501, the natural home is `@object-ui/permissions`. It owns `isLoaded` and `checkField`, it depends only on `@object-ui/types`, and fields, plugin-detail and app-shell already depend on it.
  - Adding that export is a `Clause-②: yes` change, so it is left to that card.
- **Docs.** No README or guide documents `useRecordSearch`'s options, so no doc went stale. The option's JSDoc carries the contract.
- **`page:header`** is objectui#10499, not this card.
